legal.bannerBody: We use essential cookies for sign-in and language. Payments are processed by Stripe — we never store card numbers.
legal.privacyIntro: TavsWebs Bot (bot.tavswebs.com) processes data to provide AI chat and lead services for businesses.

controller.title: Controller
controller.body: The service is provided by TavsWebs. Contact us via your bot.tavswebs.com account or tavswebs.com.

data.title: What we process
data.body: Account data (name, email), workspace content, chat transcripts, leads (name, phone, email), billing status from Stripe, and technical logs (IP, timestamps).

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Payments are processed by Stripe Checkout / Customer Portal. We never receive or store card numbers (PCI). Stripe is the controller for card data.

retention.title: Retention and rights
retention.body: You can export and delete data in the dashboard. You may request access, correction, or erasure. Complaints: your local data protection authority (in Latvia: dvi.gov.lv).

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: Essential only: session (sign-in) and language (NEXT_LOCALE). We do not use advertising trackers.
